fields.summary_ko.0: Anthropic launched Claude Sheets as an Excel alternative, but MSFT's substitution risk is limited due to integrated value of email, Teams, and cloud in Microsoft 365 subscriptions.
fields.summary_ko.1: MSFT's Microsoft 365 cloud revenue reached $27.8B in Q1 2027, up 17% YoY, continuing steady growth, with stock price up 10% since the beginning of the year.
